**Finding: deviation (Section 7.2, ¶p0027)**

Section 7.2 runs the MFN against us — we would have to extend Silverline terms no less favourable than the best terms we give any other technology supplier. It is entirely open-ended (no defined product, no term limit, no reasonable-comparison carve-outs), so it fails the fallback position and falls into walk-away territory. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment.

Redline (validated, preferred position): delete ¶7.2 in full. No Vendor-granted MFN exists elsewhere in the document, so nothing beneficial to us is lost.
